namespace PubDC03

def isOddInt (z : Int) : Prop := ∃ k : Int, z = 2 * k + 1
def isEvenInt (z : Int) : Prop := ∃ k : Int, z = 2 * k

theorem odd_add_odd_even (a b : Int) (ha : isOddInt a) (hb : isOddInt b) : isEvenInt (a + b) := by
  cases ha with
  | intro u hu =>
    cases hb with
    | intro v hv =>
      exact ⟨u + v + 1, by omega⟩
